# Root system

Root-system data of an algebra: its rank and dimension, Cartan matrix, simple and positive roots, and fundamental weights.

### Rank

`Rank[g]`

The rank of `g` -- the dimension of its Cartan subalgebra, equal to the number of simple roots.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
Rank[SO[5]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
2
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
Rank[SU[4]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text

```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

### LieAlgebraDimension

`LieAlgebraDimension[g]`

The dimension of `g` as a vector space -- equivalently, the number of generators.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
LieAlgebraDimension[SU[3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
8
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
LieAlgebraDimension[SO[5]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
10
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**Notes**

- Equals the number of defining-representation generators returned by Generators[g], and (# positive roots) * 2 + rank.

**See also:** [`Rank`](root-system#rank) · [`Generators`](algebras#generators) · [`PositiveRoots`](root-system#positiveroots)

### CartanMatrix

`CartanMatrix[g]`

The Cartan matrix of `g`: the rank-by-rank integer matrix `A[[i,j]] = 2 (a_i, a_j) / (a_j, a_j)` of pairings between simple roots and coroots.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
CartanMatrix[SU[3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{2, -1}, {-1, 2}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
CartanMatrix[SO[5]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{2, -2}, {-1, 2}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**Notes**

- For the non-simply-laced types (B, C) this is the transpose of the matrix some references (e.g. LieART) print -- CartanMatrix[SO[5]] is {{2, -2}, {-1, 2}} -- equivalently the package uses [H_i, E_j] = A[[j,i]] E_j. It is internally consistent in this convention.

**See also:** [`SimpleRoots`](root-system#simpleroots) · [`Rank`](root-system#rank) · [Concepts: conventions](../concepts#conventions)

---

### SimpleRoots

`SimpleRoots[g]`

The simple roots of `g`, as vectors in the Euclidean (orthonormal) basis. Ordered by the Bourbaki labelling of the Dynkin diagram.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
SimpleRoots[SU[3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{1, -1, 0}, {0, 1, -1}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
SimpleRoots[Sp[4]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{1, -1}, {0, 2}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`PositiveRoots`](root-system#positiveroots) · [`CartanMatrix`](root-system#cartanmatrix) · [`FundamentalWeights`](root-system#fundamentalweights)

### PositiveRoots

`PositiveRoots[g]`

All positive roots of `g`, as vectors in the Euclidean basis. There are (dim(g) - rank(g))/2 of them.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
PositiveRoots[SU[3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{1, -1, 0}, {1, 0, -1}, {0, 1, -1}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
PositiveRoots[SO[5]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{1, -1}, {1, 1}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`SimpleRoots`](root-system#simpleroots) · [`FundamentalWeights`](root-system#fundamentalweights)

### FundamentalWeights

`FundamentalWeights[g]`

The fundamental weights of `g`, as vectors in the Euclidean basis. They are dual to the simple coroots, and the Dynkin labels of a weight are its coordinates in this basis.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `g` | a Lie algebra |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
FundamentalWeights[SU[3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{2/3, -1/3, -1/3}, {1/3, 1/3, -2/3}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
FundamentalWeights[SO[5]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{{1, 0}, {1/2, 1/2}}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**Notes**

- Half-integer entries (e.g. {1/2, 1/2} for SO[5]) are the spinor fundamental weights.

**See also:** [`SimpleRoots`](root-system#simpleroots) · [`Irrep`](representations#irrep)
